set.body: From S4.6 (p0-s46 f7c2ff71). Exported figure SVGs have no <title>/<desc>: FigurePage rebuilds the scene from its panels' grobs, which drops the panels' SceneSemantics. Carry the figure-level and per-panel semantics into the export (title, desc, summary), and re-record the figure goldens through their write modes. Also cover the geometry and reference diagram scenes.
set.title: Figure export: carry scene semantics into SVG title/desc; cover diagram scenes
